key_reasoning.reason: Four components: new workspace_archive module (builder, audit, typed errors), download-all route with error mapping in agent_workspace router, AgentWorkspaceService helpers it reuses, and config limits. Reuses shared workspace_path_rules and BaseMonitoringService.

No exact precedent for in-memory multi-file zip. Security-sensitive: entry names validated against path rules to block zip-slip and reserved paths, size and file-count caps guard memory, errors mapped so internals are not leaked. Defensive edge cases (unreadable files, unsafe names, manifest name collision, too-large) are covered by new parameterized tests.
9 files changed per diffstat (6 modified including the OpenAPI baseline and REST guide, 3 new: archive module and two test files); 767 insertions across src, tests and docs.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk held at L: security-sensitive zip entry-name validation and memory-bound archive building with no exact precedent
